mapper.insert: insert into chat_credit_session(user_id, request_id, deducted, deduct_amount, deduct_state, refund_state, retry_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{requestId}, #{deducted}, #{deductAmount}, #{deductState}, #{refundState}, 0, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, request_id, deducted, deduct_amount, deduct_state, refund_state, retry_count from chat_credit_session where request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
select id, user_id, request_id, deducted, deduct_amount, deduct_state, refund_state, retry_count from chat_credit_session where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
select count(*) from chat_credit_session where refund_state = 'pending'
